summary: Filing is a Form 8-K reporting the issuance of an unsecured promissory note up to $1,000,000 by blank-check company Axiom Intelligence Acquisition Corp 1 to its sponsor for working capital. No business combination, divestiture, or special-situation event is announced. The note is convertible into units at $10.00 per unit. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
